append.detail: ── PROBE RE-POINTED 2026-10-14 (overhaul, PR #3434). The /search people query moved verbatim out of app/(main)/search/page.tsx into app/(main)/search/search-data.ts (searchPeople, shared by the DAWN page and the Frequency search body), and isListableInDirectory moved with it. The probe now reads the module the query lives in; page.tsx imports searchPeople from it.
